Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, A.C.J.
Mr. Dushyant Mainali, Advocate
for the petitioner,
2. Mr. Yogesh Pandey, Deputy
Advocate General for the State of
Uttarakhand.
3. Ms. Vidushi Pandey (through V.C.)
and Mr. Naveen Paneru, Advocates for
respondent no. 1.
4. According to petitioner, there is no
grievance redressal cell constituted in
Radhe Hari Government P.G. College,
Kashipur, as per recommendations
made by Lyngdoh Committee.
5. By means of this writ petition,
petitioner has sought the following
reliefs:-
"(I) Issue a writ, order or direction in the
nature of mandamus directing and commanding
respondent no. 3 Incharge Teacher/Kshatra Sangh
Prabhari, Students Union Election-2026, Radhe

UKHC010180662026
2026:UHC:9217
Hari Govt. Postgraduate College, Kashipur, District
Udham Singh Nagar and respondent Chairman
Grievance Redressal Cell, Radhe Hari Govt.
Postgraduate College, Kashipur, District Udham
Singh Nagar to forthwith constitute an effective
Grievance Redressal Cell in the college strictly in
terms of the provisions contained under the
recommendation No. 6.8 of the Lingdoh Committee
approved by the Hon'ble Supreme Court vide
judgment dated 22.09.2006 passed in SLP No.
24295/2004, University of Kerala v. Council
Principal Colleges Kerala, and Article 17 of the
Student Union Constitution framed by the Kumaun
University and to serve a notice of the complaint
dated 03.10.2026 preferred by the petitioner
before the Grievance Redressal Cell without any
further delay.
(II)To issue a writ, order or direction in the
nature of mandamus directing and commanding
the Grievance Redressal Cell to consider the
complaint of the petitioner dated 03.10.2026 and
to provide an effective hearing to the petitioner and
take a decision thereupon within a shortest period
of time as provided under the recommendation No.
6.8 of the Lingdoh Committee as well as Article 17
of the Student Union Constitution framed by the
Kumaun University.
(III) Issue a writ, order or direction in the
nature of mandamus directing and commanding
the respondent no. 2 Principal, Radhe Hari Govt.
Postgraduate College, Kashipur, District Udham
Singh Nagar, respondent no. 3 Incharge
Teacher/Kshatra Sangh Prabhari, Students Union
Election-2026, Radhe Hari Govt. Postgraduate
College, Kashipur, District Udham Singh Nagar,
respondent no. 4 to take immediate and effective
steps to restore and preserve the entire material,
documents related to student union election-2026
conducted for the post of President in Radhe Hari
Govt. Postgraduate College, Kashipur and to keep
the same in the safe custody so as to avoid any
tampering and manipulation thereof till the final
decision in petitioner's complaint and the
appeal/other remedy against the decision of
Grievance Redressal Cell, if any, is taken."
6. Learned State Counsel submits
that petitioner has sought a writ of

UKHC010180662026

mandamus, but without making any
representation.
7. The writ petition is, accordingly,
disposed of with liberty to petitioner to
make representation for constitution of
Grievance Redressal Cell. If he makes
representation within 48 hours,
Principal of the concerned college shall
examine the matter and pass
appropriate order, as per law, within
ten days thereafter. Principal shall also
consider passing necessary orders for
preserving the ballet papers.
(Manoj Kumar Tiwari, A.C.J.) 09.10.2026
Navin
